source_evidence: Money market funds generally fall into three categories: government money market funds; tax-exempt money market funds (also called municipal money market funds); and prime money market funds.
question: Misconception: Money market funds are all one type, so there is no need to distinguish among them.
answer: Correction: Money market funds generally fall into three categories: government, tax-exempt (also called municipal), and prime. The source also says rules vary based on the type, so it is important to understand which type you are considering.
